summary: Explore and learn about bugs: ants, bees, butterflies, beetles and more!
description:
The Bugs I: Insects? is a delightful app where children explore the miniature world of insects through interactive games, animations and narrated facts. Discover how bugs live, feed, grow and transform — all while playing and having fun!

From busy ants and buzzing bees to colorful butterflies and beetles, this app invites young explorers to learn about some of nature’s most amazing creatures.

🌼 A fun and educational experience
What do insects use their antennae for? Why do ants walk in a line? How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?
The Bugs I: Insects? answers these questions and many more through short, engaging explanations, incredible illustrations and playful mini-games.

🧠 Learn about metamorphosis, insect anatomy and behavior
🎮 Play freely — no rules, no scores, no pressure
👀 Observe, interact, and make discoveries at your own pace

✨ Key Features
🐝 Learn about the lives of insects: ants, bees, ladybugs, beetles, stick insects, praying mantises, butterflies and more
🎮 Play dozens of mini-games: build your own insect, spot the camouflaged stick bugs, complete the butterfly life cycle, dress the beekeepers, and more
🔊 Fully narrated content — perfect for pre-readers and early readers
🎨 Rich illustrations, realistic animations and hands-on learning
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Ideal for kids aged 4+ — fun for the whole family
🚫 100% ad-free and safe to use
🐛 Why choose “The Bugs I: Insects?”
Encourages curiosity about nature and science
Supports STEM learning in a creative, age-appropriate way
Fosters independent exploration, imagination and observation
Designed with love by educators and artists
Whether your child is fascinated by bugs or just curious about the world around them, this app is a safe, calm and joyful way to discover the secrets of the insect kingdom.
